1.title: Exam Orientation and How to Study
1.text: Welcome to Module zero: Exam Orientation and How to Study. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do six things. The exam at a glance. The eight objective groups. What is new in version four. How to answer every question. A study plan. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: Exam overview, objective map and answer technique (all objectives). Exam format: a one-hour online-proctored multiple-choice exam on Terraform one point one two. Validated against: the official Terraform Associate version oh oh four exam objectives.

1.title: The exam at a glance
1.text: The exam at a glance. Exam. Hashi Corp Terraform Associate, version four (the Terraform Associate exam). Format. Multiple choice, online proctored. Time. One hour. Language. English. Terraform version tested. Terraform one point one two, with H C P Terraform content. Credential. Expires after two years. Price. seventy point five zero U S dollars plus taxes and fees; a free retake is not included. Prerequisites. Basic terminal skills and an understanding of on-premises and cloud architecture. The number of questions and the passing score are not published on the pages read, so this course does not quote them. Hashi Corp does not publish weights per objective. Exam tip: Version four replaced three in January twenty twenty-six. If a practice question mentions old behavior (for example only taint and no -replace ), think of Terraform one point one two.

1.title: The eight objective groups, continued
1.text: The eight objective groups. one. Objectives: one A to one C. Topic: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. two. Objectives: two A to two D. Topic: Terraform fundamentals: providers and state. three. Objectives: three A to three G. Topic: Core workflow: init, validate, plan, apply, destroy, fmt. four. Objectives: four A to four H. Topic: Configuration: resources, data, variables, outputs, types, expressions, dependencies, custom conditions, sensitive data.

1.title: The eight objective groups, continued
1.text: The eight objective groups. five. Objectives: five A to five D. Topic: Modules. six. Objectives: six A to six D. Topic: State management: backends, locking, drift. seven. Objectives: seven A to seven C. Topic: Maintain infrastructure: import, state C L I, logging. eight. Objectives: eight A to eight D. Topic: H C P Terraform. Exam tip: Group four has eight objectives, the most of any group. Configuration and the core workflow are where most questions live.

1.title: What is new in version 004
1.text: What is new in version four. four F depends on and create before destroy lifecycle rules. Module eight. four G Validate configuration with custom conditions. Module nine. four H Ephemeral values and write-only arguments. Module ten. eight C Organize and use H C P Terraform workspaces and projects. Module sixteen.

1.title: How to answer every question
1.text: How to answer every question. Read the last line to see what is asked: a command, a block, a file or a behavior. Find the objective group the question belongs to. Eliminate answers with the wrong command, the wrong block type or a cloud-specific detail (provider detail is not tested). Remember the safe default: plan before apply, state is sensitive, never edit state by hand, pin versions. Answer every question; there is no stated penalty for a wrong answer. Exam tip: The exam asks what a command or block does, not for long code. Learn each command in one sentence.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A candidate asks which Terraform version the Terraform Associate version oh oh four exam tests. What is the answer? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Terraform one point one two, including H C P Terraform content. Version four tests Terraform one point one two and includes H C P Terraform content.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. How long is the Terraform Associate exam, and how is it delivered? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: One hour, online proctored, multiple choice. The exam lasts one hour, is multiple choice and is online proctored.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which topic is new in version four compared with version three? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Ephemeral values and write-only arguments. Ephemeral values and write-only arguments are new, along with custom conditions, lifecycle rules in four F and workspaces and projects in H C P Terraform.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A question mentions a detail that only applies to one cloud provider. How should a candidate treat it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: As unnecessary detail, since provider specifics are not tested. Provider-specific knowledge is not necessary for the exam.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. Which objective group has the most objectives? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Group four, Terraform configuration. Group four has eight objectives, four A to four H.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. What happens to the credential after it is earned? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: It expires after two years. The credential expires after two years.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How long is the exam? Answer: One hour. Question two. Which Terraform version is tested? Answer: Terraform one point one two. Question three. How many objective groups are there? Answer: Eight.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Which group is about H C P Terraform? Answer: Group eight. Question five. How long is the credential valid? Answer: Two years. Question six. Is the question count published? Answer: No.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Format: one hour, multiple choice, online proctored, Terraform one point one two. Groups: one I A C, two fundamentals, three workflow, four configuration, five modules, six state, seven maintain, eight H C P Terraform. New in four: lifecycle rules, custom conditions, ephemeral values and write-only arguments, workspaces and projects. Method: find the group, eliminate wrong commands, safe defaults.
